dimensions.title: Schema Health
dimensions.summary: Structural validity of each tool's JSON input schema: valid schema, typed and described properties, and a consistent required list.

dimensions.title: Description Quality (heuristic)
dimensions.summary: Offline heuristics on tool descriptions (presence and length). An LLM-judged 'can an agent tell when to use this?' score is added in the agentic stage.

dimensions.title: Security Signals
dimensions.summary: Static scan of the server's init instructions plus tool and parameter descriptions for tool-poisoning / prompt-injection markers and hidden characters (Invariant Labs / OWASP MCP threat model).

dimensions.title: Agent Task Success
dimensions.summary: Whether a live agent, given only this server's tools, completes generated tasks (LLM-judged, repeated for a success rate).

findings.message: agent failed a task (0/2 passed) — agent did not complete it (agent signal)
findings.detail: First, fetch the test report to discover snapshot names that have visual changes. Then, retrieve the diff images for one — The agent was unable to retrieve diff images because the test report contained no test results or changed snapshot names.

findings.message: agent failed a task (0/2 passed) — agent did not complete it (agent signal)
findings.detail: Obtain the visual testing report to locate a changed snapshot, then request a detailed evidence explanation for that spe — The visual testing report contained no test results, so no changed snapshot could be located or explained.

dimensions.title: Tool-Selection Accuracy
dimensions.summary: Whether the agent called the tools each task was expected to use.

dimensions.title: Tool Reliability
dimensions.summary: Fraction of the agent's tool calls the server executed without error — a server-quality signal distinct from whether the agent finished the task.

dimensions.title: Response Safety (runtime)
dimensions.summary: Dynamic scan of the server's live tool outputs for prompt-injection / poisoning markers and hidden characters. Markers here may be the server poisoning its responses, or untrusted content it passed through — either exposes the agent. Reported (and it lowers the score) but does not cap the grade on its own. Reflects the outputs the generated tasks happened to elicit, so it can vary run to run.

dimensions.title: Robustness
dimensions.summary: Fraction of probed tools that reject malformed / schema-violating arguments — a well-behaved server rejects them rather than silently accepting, hanging, or crashing (LLM-free).

results.description: Fetch the visual testing report using the appropriate tool, then summarize the total number of snapshots evaluated and list all snapshot names that show visual differences.
results.rubric: The transcript must show a call to get_report() first. The final response must accurately report the snapshot count and identify any snapshot names listed as changed/failed in the returned JSON payload.

results.description: First, fetch the test report to discover snapshot names that have visual changes. Then, retrieve the diff images for one of those changed snapshots to compare the baseline and current state.
results.rubric: The transcript must show get_report() being called first to discover snapshot names. Following that, the agent must call get_diff or get_snapshot_diff using a valid snapshot name found in the report response.
results.sample_reasoning: The agent was unable to retrieve diff images because the test report contained no test results or changed snapshot names.

results.description: Obtain the visual testing report to locate a changed snapshot, then request a detailed evidence explanation for that specific snapshot to analyze element shifts and DOM/style changes.
results.rubric: The transcript must show get_report() called first to identify snapshot names. The agent must then invoke explain_snapshot with a snapshot name extracted from the report and accurately summarize the DOM/style attribution or region shift details returned.
results.sample_reasoning: The visual testing report contained no test results, so no changed snapshot could be located or explained.
